method.workflow: IP-Adapter + ControlNet, followed by feather-band inpaint on the most stable pose candidate

summary: Guide-first generation improved pose stability and kept more folded-arm feather intent than prompt-only RealVisXL, but the best outputs still read as striped/scaly generic theropods rather than densely feathered dromaeosaurs. The feather-band inpaint pass did not convert the texture into convincing plumage.
primaryRejectReasons: body surface remains stripe/scaly instead of dense downy feathers
folded forelimb feathers are too weak for a LoRA concept seed
sickle-claw cue remains absent or unclear
some generated poses float above the ground or break leg anatomy
selected stable poses are too close to the existing weak app compromise
nextRoute: Create stronger project-owned feather references before LoRA expansion: either hand-authored paintover/segmentation references, a ControlNet guide with explicit feather masses, or a different feather-aware checkpoint. Do not add these outputs to seed_manifest.json as train_seed.
